title: 第341章 圣女下第340章 圣女上
content_zh:
弗嘉丽下意识回过头，目光越过母亲的肩膀，落在了那道站在人群后排的身影上。
洛一也正望着她。
弗嘉丽收回目光，深吸一口气，然后一步一步走向那座石台。
她抬起手，将手掌覆上那枚晶石的表面。
晶石冰凉而光滑，触感细腻。
弗嘉丽垂着眼帘，什么也没有想。但下一瞬，一股温热的暖流从她的掌心涌出，如同溪流入海，无声地渗入那枚晶石之中。
紧接着，整颗晶石猛然亮了起来。那光芒从内部迸发而出，明亮而纯粹，如同一颗微缩的太阳被托在石台上。
但那只是开始。
光芒顺着石台蔓延而下，攀上冰冷的石质底座，如同流水般漫过地面。
然后它触及了那座光明女神像的底座，如同被点燃的引线，柔和的光从底座一路向上攀升，沿着衣褶的线条流过那模糊的面容，最终在神像的眉眼处凝聚成一片温润的辉光。
整座雕像，如同苏醒了一般。
圣光从神像的轮廓中涌出，将整座小教堂映照得如同白昼，尘埃在光柱中浮动如同金色的细沙，连墙壁上的裂缝都被这光芒抚平了轮廓。
红袍主教的呼吸停了一瞬。
他怔怔地望着那座发光的雕像，然后，在所有村民屏息的目光中，他迈步上前，在弗嘉丽的面前缓缓单膝跪了下来。
红色的祭袍在地面上铺开，如同一片深色的暖流。
“恭迎圣女降世。”
身后，那些银甲骑士与白袍神官在同一时刻齐刷刷地单膝跪地，甲胄碰撞出整齐的轻响。
“恭迎圣女降世。”
弗嘉丽的手还悬在那枚晶石上方。
光芒映在她的脸上，她的眼睛微微睁大，浅金色的瞳孔里映着那些跪伏的身影，一片无措的空白在眼底铺开。

她下意识地回过头，越过那些低垂的头颅，望向了人群后排的方向。
洛一站在那里。
他依旧望着她，然后，他笑着，朝她比了一个大拇指。
弗嘉丽心中的慌乱就这么莫名地平复下来。
圣女降世自是要被带回光明大教堂的。
当天晚上，弗嘉丽的家里灯火通明。
她的母亲坐在桌边，眼眶红红的，脸上的笑容却怎么也压不住。
父亲倒了一杯麦酒，端起来又放下，放下又端起来，反复了好几次，最后只是笑着拍了拍弗嘉丽的头顶。
“好孩子……”他声音有些哑，只说了这一句，便没能再说下去了。
弗嘉丽坐在他们中间，被温暖的灯火和父母的喜悦包裹着，却总觉得心里有一块地方空荡荡的，像有什么东西正在无声地松动。
直到夜深了，父母终于回房休息。她推开院门，踩着月光，穿过那条熟悉的小径，跑到了教堂后面那间废弃的小屋前。
洛一正坐在门槛上，月光落在他肩头，将那身洗得发白的旧衣衫染成银灰色。
他手里还握着那本翻旧了的魔法书，但并没有在看，只是随意地搭在膝上。
弗嘉丽跑到他面前，弯下腰撑着膝盖喘了好几下，然后直起身，望着他。
她的眼睛在月光下亮晶晶的，像盛满了碎银。
content_en:
Fujiali turned around subconsciously, looking over her mother's shoulder and landing on the figure standing in the back row of the crowd.
Luo Yi was also looking at her.
Fu Jiali looked away, took a deep breath, and then walked towards the stone platform step by step.
She raised her hand and placed her palm on the surface of the crystal.
The crystal is cold and smooth, delicate to the touch.
Fujiali lowered her eyes and thought of nothing. But in the next moment, a warm current surged out from her palm, like a stream flowing into the sea, silently seeping into the crystal.
Immediately afterwards, the entire crystal suddenly lit up. The light burst out from within, bright and pure, like a miniature sun held up on a stone platform.
But that's just the beginning.
The light spreads down the stone platform, climbs up the cold stone base, and covers the ground like flowing water.
Then it touched the base of the statue of the Goddess of Light, like a ignited lead. The soft light climbed all the way up from the base, flowed along the lines of the folds of the clothes and through the blurred face, and finally condensed into a warm glow at the brows and eyes of the statue.
The whole statue seemed to have awakened.
Holy light poured out from the outline of the statue, illuminating the entire chapel like daylight. Dust floated in the light pillar like golden sand, and even the cracks on the wall were smoothed by the light.
The red-robed bishop's breath stopped for a moment.
He stared blankly at the luminous statue, and then, under the breathless gazes of all the villagers, he stepped forward and slowly knelt down on one knee in front of Fujiali.
The red sacrificial robes were spread out on the ground, like a dark stream of warmth.
"Welcome to the birth of the Saint."
Behind them, the knights in silver armor and the priests in white robes all knelt down on one knee at the same moment, and their armors collided with each other with a neat sound.
"Welcome to the birth of the Saint."
Fujiali's hand was still hanging above the crystal.
The light reflected on her face, and her eyes widened slightly. The kneeling figures were reflected in the light golden pupils, and a helpless blankness spread in her eyes.
She subconsciously turned her head, looking past the lowered heads toward the back row of the crowd.
Luo Yi stood there.
He still looked at her, then, he smiled and gave her a thumbs up.
The panic in Fujiali's heart calmed down inexplicably.
When the saint comes to the world, she will be taken back to the Cathedral of Light.
That night, Fujiali's home was brightly lit.
Her mother was sitting at the table, her eyes were red, but she couldn't suppress the smile on her face.
The father poured a glass of ale, put it up and put it down, put it down and picked it up again, repeated several times, and finally just smiled and patted Fujiali on the head.
"Good boy..." His voice was a little hoarse, and he couldn't continue after saying this.
Fu Jiali sat among them, wrapped in the warm lights and her parents' joy, but she always felt that there was an empty place in her heart, as if something was silently loosening.
It wasn't until late at night that my parents finally went back to their room to rest. She pushed open the courtyard door, stepped on the moonlight, crossed the familiar path, and ran to the abandoned hut behind the church.
Luo Yi was sitting on the threshold, and the moonlight fell on his shoulders, dyeing the white washed old clothes into silver gray.
He still held the well-thumbed magic book in his hand, but he was not reading it, he just put it casually on his lap.
Fujiali ran up to him, bent down and propped up her knees to gasp for several times, then straightened up and looked at him.
Her eyes sparkled in the moonlight, as if they were filled with broken silver.
